decisions.statement: A seat that kept nothing is stopped.
A seat whose process is gone is stopped whatever the records say.
A seat whose process cannot be read is not stopped for being unreadable.
A working seat is read as working before the records the seat waits on are read.
A seat in an on-call role is ready for more work rather than idle.
A seat in an on-call role is ready for more work though a turn it arranged is still to come.
A seat ready for work is told apart from a seat waiting on a turn already arranged.
The role's on-call flag decides rather than the seat's own on-call flag.
A seat in no on-call role waiting on nothing is idle rather than waiting.
A seat that has taken no turn at all is stopped whatever its role.
An unread record and a record reading false are told apart.

definition: a seat read as working, idle, waiting or stopped, from the records kept and the process named
